sloka: अन्या तूशनसः पत्नी ययातेः पुरुषर्षभ ।न तु सा दयिता राज्ञो देवयानी सुमध्यमा ।। ७.५८.९ ॥
transliteration: anyā tūśanasaḥ patnī yayāteḥ puruṣarṣabha ।na tu sā dayitā rājño devayānī sumadhyamā ।। 7.58.9 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, the other wife of Yayati was Devayani, the daughter of Ushanas, but that slender-waisted Devayani was not beloved by the king.
